title: Village councilor shot dead in broad daylight in Poblacion Dalican, Datu Odin Sinsuat
summary: A village councilor named Beno was shot in the back by unidentified gunmen on a motorcycle while riding a payong-payong tricycle along the Bungued-Dalican farm-to-market road near the public market in Barangay Poblacion Dalican, Datu Odin Sinsuat, Maguindanao del Norte, in October 2026. He died at the scene.

sources.title: Village councilor shot dead in broad daylight in Maguindanao del Norte
